name: Orange Chipmunk 72
author: WhiteNervosa
description: Dark green checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #000000 to #2c2c2c, text color changes from #ffffff to #ffffff, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px -4px 1px 0px inset, #ffffff 0px -1px 1px 0px, #000000 0px 2px 4px 1px. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #000000 to #2d6737, text color changes from #ffffff to #ffffff, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px -4px 1px 0px inset, #ffffff 0px -1px 1px 0px, #000000 0px 2px 4px 1px.
